input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, perfectly upright typewriter-style serif letters, never italic, never slanted, never redrawn, never morphing. A cheerful young Japanese woman with a black bob haircut at a warm whisky bar, holding a whisky glass at shoulder height beside her body. She breaks into a big, bright, happy smile, raises the glass a little toward the camera in a toast and says in a bright, cheerful young female voice in Japanese: 「かんぱい！」 Her lips move in sync. Then she keeps smiling warmly at the camera, eyes crinkling with joy, the ice in the glass clinks and her bob hair sways. The glass and her arm stay outside her chest and never cover the print; her chest and the T-shirt stay calm. Audio: only her voice, the clink of ice and a very faint quiet bar ambience, no music, no other voices. Warm bokeh lights glimmer in the background. Avoid: zoom, zooming in, zooming out, camera push-in, dolly, pan, tilt, camera shake, garbled text, changing letters, misspelled words, nonsense text, extra text, new text, morphing print, print redrawing, italic letters, slanted letters, warped logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, face morphing, identity change, different person, teeth distortion, flicker, watermark, captions, subtitles, glass covering the print, arm crossing the chest, body twisting, spilling, music, singing, English speech, extra words
